### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/23737, https://github.com/pingcap/tics/issues/1703  { #22941 (the previous PR https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/22955 also introduce a bug) }<!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

issue_context.title: planner: wrong results from outer join
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
drop table if exists m, mp
CREATE TABLE m (
		mid varchar(50) NOT NULL,
		ParentId varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
		PRIMARY KEY (mid),
		KEY ind_bm_parent (ParentId,mid)
	);
CREATE TABLE mp (
		mpid bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
		mid varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '模块主键',
		sid int,
	PRIMARY KEY (mpid)
	);
insert into mp values("1","1","0");
insert into m values("0", "0");
SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM m WHERE ParentId = c.mid ) expand,  bmp.mpid,  bmp.mpid IS NULL,bmp.mpid IS NOT NULL, sid FROM m c LEFT JOIN mp bmp ON c.mid = bmp.mid  WHERE c.ParentId = '0'

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
`1 <nil> 1 0 <nil>`

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
`1 <nil> 0 0 <nil>`

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
master
<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
